default.activation: If Pure Tokens Skills are already available in this conversation, use them directly. Otherwise use this client's Skill loading controls; open a new conversation only when required by the client. Loading is not verified by installation.
examples: Generate an image of a lake at sunset.

zcode.activation: If Skills are already available in this ZCode conversation, use them directly. Otherwise refresh and enable the installed Skills in ZCode; start a new conversation if this session still cannot load them.

trae.activation: If Skills are already available in this TRAE conversation, use them directly. Otherwise refresh or enable Pure Tokens Skills in TRAE Settings > Skills; start a new conversation if this session still cannot load them. API use requires a saved supported connection.
